Key Features & Advantages

Non-Sparking Components

Eliminates potential friction sparks during operation in volatile atmospheres.

ATEX Zone 1 & 2 Approved

Safe for explosive gases, vapors, and combustible dust environments.

Double Pawl Safety

Enclosed Weston brake mechanism ensures reliable non-slip load holding.

Standards & Compliance

ATEX Directive 2014/34/EU

Equipment for potentially explosive atmospheres.

EN 13157 Compliance

Certified hoist lifting safety standards.

Product Overview

Designed specifically for oil refineries, chemical plants, offshore gas extraction platforms, paint spray facilities, and grain processing facilities where spark risk could trigger catastrophic ignition.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which models of the Europull Spark Proof Chain Hoist are available?

The Europull Spark Proof Chain Hoist is available in 5 models: EPC-EX05, EPC-EX10, EPC-EX20, EPC-EX30, EPC-EX50. Capacity (Tons) ranges from 0.5 Ton to 5.0 Ton. Full figures for every model are in the technical specifications table on this page.

What capacity range does the Europull Spark Proof Chain Hoist cover?

The Europull Spark Proof Chain Hoist covers 0.5t - 20t.

Which standard does the Europull Spark Proof Chain Hoist comply with?

The Europull Spark Proof Chain Hoist is manufactured to ATEX / EN 13157.

What aTEX Classification does the Europull Spark Proof Chain Hoist have?

The Europull Spark Proof Chain Hoist's aTEX Classification: ATEX Ex II 2GD c IIB T4 / Zone 1, 2 Gas & Dust.

What hook Material does the Europull Spark Proof Chain Hoist have?

The Europull Spark Proof Chain Hoist's hook Material: Solid Copper-Beryllium / High-Grade Aluminum Bronze.

What load Chain does the Europull Spark Proof Chain Hoist have?

The Europull Spark Proof Chain Hoist's load Chain: Calibrated Stainless Steel / Bronze Coated Alloy Chain.

How do I request a quotation for the Europull Spark Proof Chain Hoist?
